resource.title:
## Context
Repository: simik394/osobni_wf
Working directory: agents/rsrch/
Default branch is now: consolidation-v1

## Task: Fix Build Script to Enforce Type Safety

### Problem
Build silently ignores ALL TypeScript errors:

1. `agents/rsrch/package.json` build script: `"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json || true && cp src/selectors.yaml dist/"` — `|| true` swallows all errors
2. `agents/rsrch/tsconfig.json`: `"noEmitOnError": false` — emits JS even with type errors

### Fixes:

#### 1. package.json build script
Change to: `"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/selectors.yaml dist/"`

#### 2. tsconfig.json noEmitOnError
Change `"noEmitOnError": false` to `"noEmitOnError": true`

#### 3. Update ES target in tsconfig.json
Change target from `"es2018"` to `"es2022"`. Update lib from `["es2018", "dom"]` to `["es2022", "dom"]`.

#### 4. Add server.log to .gitignore
Add `server.log` line to `agents/rsrch/.gitignore`. Delete `agents/rsrch/server.log`.

## Constraints
- Modify ONLY: package.json (build script), tsconfig.json (target/lib/noEmitOnError), .gitignore, server.log
- Do NOT touch any other files
- Do NOT modify agents/shared/

pullRequest.title: Fix agents/rsrch Build Script and Enforce Type Safety
pullRequest.description:
This change addresses the issue where TypeScript errors were being silently swallowed during the build of `agents/rsrch`.

By removing `|| true` from the package.json build script and enabling `noEmitOnError`, type errors now correctly fail the build. The ES target and lib have been bumped to `es2022` as requested, and `server.log` has been correctly ignored.
